name: Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text:
The report calls for a larger EU budget after 2027, moving away from the 1% spending cap. It wants money for shared priorities, continued cohesion funding to reduce inequality, and more defence spending without cutting cohesion. It rejects merging programmes into one competitiveness fund and wants crisis reserves, simpler rules with proper checks, and respect for EU values. It also asks for flexible funding, more money for farming, transport, culture, education and tourism, and stronger links between EU money and rule of law.

- Bigger budget after 2027, with crisis reserves and continued cohesion funding.
- Reject merging programmes; keep farm, transport, education and culture funds separate.
- Tie EU money to rule of law and respect for EU values.
